name: leverage_ratio_ccf_exposure_shortfall_para
question_template: Use solely the fictional, scenario-specific leverage rule set out here. Before any deductions, gross Tier 1 capital stands at {GROSS_T1} USD million. The entire goodwill balance of {GOODWILL} USD million is deducted. Deferred tax assets amount to {DTA} USD million, and only the portion exceeding {DTA_THRESH_PCT} percent of gross Tier 1 capital is deducted; when the DTA do not exceed that threshold, there is no DTA deduction at all. The exposure measure is the sum of two items: on-balance-sheet assets of {ON_BS} USD million, counted in full, and undrawn commitments of {UNDRAWN} USD million, counted at {CCF_PCT} percent of their notional amount. The leverage ratio, expressed in percent, equals Tier 1 capital after deductions divided by the exposure measure, multiplied by 100. The required minimum ratio is {MIN_PCT} percent. The capital shortfall is the extra Tier 1 capital, in USD million, needed to lift the ratio to exactly the minimum while the exposure measure stays the same; it is 0 whenever the ratio is already at or above the minimum. Should Tier 1 capital after deductions be zero or negative, the case is invalid. Carry every value exactly. Give Tier 1 capital after deductions, the exposure measure, the leverage ratio in percent, and lastly the capital shortfall.

slots.description: Tier 1 capital after goodwill and excess deferred tax asset deductions, USD million
On-balance-sheet assets plus credit-converted undrawn commitments, USD million
Tier 1 after deductions relative to exposure measure, in percentage points

program:
def solve():
    gross_t1 = Q(P["GROSS_T1"])
    goodwill = Q(P["GOODWILL"])
    dta = Q(P["DTA"])
    thresh_pct = Q(P["DTA_THRESH_PCT"])
    on_bs = Q(P["ON_BS"])
    undrawn = Q(P["UNDRAWN"])
    ccf_pct = Q(P["CCF_PCT"])
    min_pct = Q(P["MIN_PCT"])

    dta_threshold = gross_t1 * thresh_pct / Q(100)
    dta_deduction = dta - dta_threshold
    if dta_deduction < 0:
        dta_deduction = Q(0)
    tier1_after = gross_t1 - goodwill - dta_deduction
    if tier1_after <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Tier 1 capital after deductions is not positive")

    exposure = on_bs + undrawn * ccf_pct / Q(100)
    leverage_pct = tier1_after / exposure * Q(100)

    required_t1 = exposure * min_pct / Q(100)
    shortfall = required_t1 - tier1_after
    if shortfall < 0:
        shortfall = Q(0)

    return {
        "final": shortfall,
        "tier1_after_deductions": tier1_after,
        "exposure_measure": exposure,
        "leverage_ratio_percent": leverage_pct,
    }
